title: Accounting for Irregular State Transitions through Belief Estimation in Online Medical Consultation
abstract: arXiv:2611.01474v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While online medical consultation broadens access, unprompted patient disclosures and topic shifts frequently disrupt clinician inquiry, leaving clinical states progressively revealed. We characterize these dynamics using both existing evaluation metrics and task-specific interaction metrics designed in this work. Through an empirical study across 16 medical dialogue datasets, we show that authentic online interactions exhibit substantially lower contextual continuity and higher unpredictability than offline and simulated benchmarks. We propose PRISM (Policy Reasoning with Inferred States for Medicine), a framework inspired by partially observable Markov decision processes that decouples latent state estimation from action selection to address drifting dialogue trajectories. translated_title: 通过信念估计应对在线医疗咨询中的不规则状态转移
translated_abstract: 在线医疗咨询虽然拓宽了医疗服务的可及性，但患者未经提示的主动披露和话题转换常常打断临床医生的问诊过程，使临床状态被逐步揭示。我们使用现有评估指标以及本工作专门设计的任务特定交互指标来刻画这些动态特性。通过一项涵盖16个医疗对话数据集的实证研究，我们发现真实的在线交互相较于离线和模拟基准表现出显著更低的上下文连续性和更高的不可预测性。我们提出了PRISM（Policy Reasoning with Inferred States for Medicine，基于推断状态的医学策略推理），一个受部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程启发的框架，它将潜在状态估计与动作选择解耦，以应对漂移的对话轨迹。具体而言，PRISM将临床分诊分解为信念估计、策略优化和回复生成三个环节，并通过维护一个不断演化的后验信念分布……
tldr: 该论文通过实证研究发现真实在线医疗咨询具有上下文连续性低、不可预测性高的特点，并提出受部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）启发的PRISM框架，通过将潜在状态信念估计与动作选择解耦来应对对话轨迹漂移，从而提升临床分诊能力。
en_tdlr: Revealing that authentic online medical consultations exhibit substantially lower contextual continuity and higher unpredictability than offline and simulated benchmarks, this paper proposes PRISM, a POMDP-inspired framework that decouples latent belief estimation from action selection to handle drifting dialogue trajectories in clinical triage.
